content_universe: IMARPOR — Puerto de Buenaventura · Andrea Mosquera (recién egresada SENA) en su primera semana en muelle internacional · Captain Lopera (capitán BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS · ELF speaker) · CML CARRIER (vessel cliente). Grammar emerges from real port operations: locating containers on the dock (prepositions of place), narrating routine vessel operations (simple present 3rd person -s), confirming vessel identity and location (be), declaring presence of port resources (there is/there are).

universe_anchor.grammar_lives_in_context: Each grammar group is introduced through IMARPOR port utterances anchored in the Master Anchor Text (PM-2.3) — Andrea on the dock, Lopera on the bridge, the CML CARRIER berthing — NOT through isolated drill sentences. Examples ALWAYS reference vessel · bow · stern · port · dock · berth · container · captain.

prepositions_of_place: The container is ON the dock. (Andrea points at Berth 4)
The pilot is ON the bridge. (Lopera radios shore)
The lifejacket is UNDER the seat. (Safety briefing on bridge)
The crane is BEHIND the warehouse. (Andrea reports position)
The tug is IN FRONT OF the bow. (Maneuvering report)
The CML CARRIER is BETWEEN Berth 3 and Berth 4. (Port control log)
The forklift is NEXT TO the container. (Loading bay)
The captain is AT the gangway. (Boarding moment)
simple_present_3rd_person_s: Andrea LOADS the manifest into the system.
The crane UNLOADS twenty containers per hour.
The BUENAVENTURA EXPRESS DEPARTS for Manzanillo.
The tug BERTHS the vessel safely.
The pilot SAILS the ship into port.
be_consolidate: The captain IS Lopera. (Crew list confirmation)
The stern lines ARE secured. (Berthing report)
there_is_there_are_consolidate: THERE IS a tug at the bow.
THERE IS a forklift on the dock.
THERE ARE three containers at Berth 4.
THERE ARE two pilots on the bridge.
THERE IS a captain on every vessel.

block_1_prepositions_of_place.visual_pattern: [NOUN] [BE] [PREP] [the] [PORT-NOUN] · diagrama mental: dibujo del muelle con flechas a las 8 preposiciones

archetype_A_DISCOVERY_CR.label: ARQUETIPO A — DISCOVERY & CONSCIOUSNESS-RAISING
archetype_A_DISCOVERY_CR.fundamento: El aprendiz descubre el patrón de prepositions y -s observando un corpus auténtico de utterances IMARPOR del Master Anchor Text. La regla emerge de los datos · NO se impone.

DISCOVERY.instruccion_bilingue: Read the 8 sentences. Underline the preposition. (*Lee las 8 oraciones. Subraya la preposición.*)
corpus_8_oraciones_imarpor: The container is ON the dock.
The captain is AT the gangway.
The lifejacket is UNDER the seat.
The crane is BEHIND the warehouse.
The tug is IN FRONT OF the bow.
The CML CARRIER is BETWEEN Berth 3 and Berth 4.
The forklift is NEXT TO the container.
The pilot is ON the bridge.
guiding_questions: Where is each noun? On top? Below? Beside?
What word comes BEFORE 'the dock', 'the gangway', 'the bow'?

VERIFICATION.instruccion_bilingue: Match the preposition to the picture of Berth 4. (*Empareja la preposición con la imagen del Muelle 4.*)
VERIFICATION.scaffold: Mapa visual del Berth 4 con CML CARRIER + tug + forklift + crane + warehouse + container · 8 etiquetas con espacios
VERIFICATION.rule_in_learners_words: Learners write in their own words: '_______ tells WHERE something is at the port.'

APPLICATION.instruccion_bilingue: Categorize: which sentence is correct? (*Categoriza: ¿cuál oración es correcta?*)
items_correct_vs_incorrect: ✅ The captain is at the gangway. / ❌ The captain is on the gangway between.
✅ The tug is in front of the bow. / ❌ The tug is in front the bow.
✅ The forklift is next to the container. / ❌ The forklift next to is the container.
APPLICATION.transferencia_a_pm29: Función: 'Locate port resources' (information exchange por radio VHF — base SMCP)

archetype_A_DISCOVERY_CR.micro_capsula: > ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** A1.2 prepositions describe POSITION. Use IN for inside (in the container) · ON for surface (on the dock) · AT for a specific point (at the gangway).

archetype_B_CONTROLLED_PRACTICE.label: ARQUETIPO B — CONTROLLED PRACTICE
archetype_B_CONTROLLED_PRACTICE.fundamento: Después de descubrir el patrón en A · el aprendiz lo automatiza con drills cortos y gap-fills sobre el dominio IMARPOR. Foco: precisión antes de fluidez.

PRACTICE_drill_substitution.modelo_imarpor: The captain IS at the gangway. → The pilot IS at the gangway. → The forklift IS at the gangway.
PRACTICE_drill_substitution.ronda_pares: 8 cambios sucesivos manteniendo IS + AT estructura

PRACTICE_gap_fill_prepositions.instruccion_bilingue: Fill the blank with the correct preposition. (*Completa con la preposición correcta.*)
items: The CML CARRIER is ___ Berth 3 and Berth 4. (between)
The forklift is ___ to the container. (next)
The tug is ___ ___ ___ the bow. (in front of)

PRACTICE_gap_fill_3rd_person_s.instruccion_bilingue: Add -s if needed. (*Añade -s si es necesario.*)

PRODUCTION_minima.instruccion_bilingue: Write 4 sentences about your dock. Use 1 preposition + 1 verb with -s. (*Escribe 4 oraciones sobre tu muelle. Usa 1 preposición + 1 verbo con -s.*)
PRODUCTION_minima.andamiaje: Fórmula visible · Toolbelt nouns disponibles · ejemplo modelo en pizarra

archetype_B_CONTROLLED_PRACTICE.micro_capsula: > 🎧 **Audio Cue:** When you say a 3rd-person verb · the -s sounds like /s/ (loads) or /z/ (arrives). Practice both before VHF radio.

archetype_C_COMMUNICATIVE_TASKS.label: ARQUETIPO C — COMMUNICATIVE GRAMMAR TASKS
archetype_C_COMMUNICATIVE_TASKS.fundamento: La gramática emerge de una tarea de info-gap entre 'Andrea en muelle' y 'Lopera en bridge'. Para resolver el problema · los aprendices DEBEN usar prepositions + 3rd-person-s. La tarea las atrapa.

TASK_BRIEFING.escenario: Pareja A (Andrea · en muelle Berth 4) tiene mapa con posiciones del CML CARRIER + tug + forklift + crane + container. Pareja B (Lopera · en bridge) tiene el mismo mapa pero con 5 huecos. B debe completar su mapa preguntándole a A.
TASK_BRIEFING.restriccion_que_atrapa_gramatica: B solo puede preguntar usando 'Where IS the ___?' y A solo puede responder con 'The ___ IS [PREP] the ___' · adicionalmente A reporta 1 operación con -s ('The crane unloads containers').

TASK_EXECUTION.interaccion: B pregunta · A responde · B dibuja en su mapa · cambian roles · A pregunta operación 3rd-person · B responde con verbo+S
TASK_EXECUTION.estructura_atrapada_prep: Preposiciones (forzadas por la pregunta Where IS)
TASK_EXECUTION.estructura_atrapada_3ps: Simple present 3rd person -s (forzada por reporte operacional)

LANGUAGE_FOCUS_post_task.reflexion_bilingue: Which preposition did you use most? (*¿Qué preposición usaste más?*) Did you add -s to the verb? (*¿Le pusiste -s al verbo?*)
LANGUAGE_FOCUS_post_task.conexion_pm29: Función PM-2.9: Information Exchange (radio VHF dock-to-bridge)

archetype_C_COMMUNICATIVE_TASKS.micro_capsula: > ⚠️ **Safety Rule:** Always confirm position with a preposition on VHF. 'Container at Berth 4' is NOT the same as 'Container on Berth 4'. Position errors cost money at the port.

archetype_D_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.label: ARQUETIPO D — CREATIVE PRODUCTION
archetype_D_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.fundamento: Producción creativa CONTROLADA (sentence combining) · NO libre. El aprendiz fusiona oraciones simples sobre operación del CML CARRIER usando 'and' / 'but' básico · manteniendo prepositions y -s correctos.

WARM_UP.modelo: Pares de oraciones simples → fusión: 'The CML CARRIER arrives at 06:00. The pilot is on the bridge.' → 'The CML CARRIER arrives at 06:00 and the pilot is on the bridge.'

CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.instruccion_bilingue: Combine each pair into 1 sentence using AND. Keep -s and prepositions. (*Combina cada par en 1 oración con AND. Conserva -s y preposiciones.*)
items: The vessel arrives at 06:00. // The crane unloads containers. → ___
The captain is at the gangway. // The pilot is on the bridge. → ___
Andrea loads the manifest. // The forklift is next to the container. → ___
The CML CARRIER is between Berth 3 and Berth 4. // The tug berths the vessel. → ___
CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.produccion_andrea_microfable: Write 3 sentences about Andrea's morning at the dock (use 1 preposition + 2 verbs with -s).

EVALUATION_calidad_precision.checklist: ¿Hay preposición correcta? ¿Hay -s en 3rd person? ¿AND conecta dos cláusulas?

archetype_D_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.micro_capsula: > ⚠️ **Grammar Rule:** Combining ≠ Creating. Keep your sentences SHORT and TRUE to what happens at Berth 4.

archetype_E_EDITING_ERROR_ANALYSIS.label: ARQUETIPO E — EDITING & ERROR ANALYSIS
archetype_E_EDITING_ERROR_ANALYSIS.fundamento: El aprendiz revisa un reporte de muelle de Andrea con 6 errores sistemáticos (3 preposition · 3 missing-s) · los detecta · corrige · justifica. La capacidad de auto-corrección se transfiere al PROPIO texto que escribirá en PM-2.4.
archetype_E_EDITING_ERROR_ANALYSIS.bloom: L3 (aplicar regla a corrección · clave dada · NO evaluar libre)

EXPOSURE.texto_andrea_con_errores: Berth 4 — 06:30 · Andrea reports: The CML CARRIER arrive at six. The captain is in the gangway. The pilot is on bridge. The crane unload twenty containers. The forklift next to is the container. Captain Lopera handle the maneuver.
EXPOSURE.instruccion_bilingue: Find 6 mistakes (3 prepositions · 3 missing -s). (*Encuentra 6 errores: 3 de preposiciones y 3 de -s faltante.*)

self_editing_checklist_for_pm24: [ ] Did I use a preposition with every position word?
[ ] Is the preposition in / on / at / under / behind / in front of / next to / between?
[ ] Does my 3rd-person verb (vessel · captain · crane · pilot · Andrea · CML CARRIER) end in -s?
[ ] Did I write 'the' before port-nouns (the dock / the bridge / the gangway)?
[ ] Are be (is/are) and there is/there are correct?

language_bank_e: We need -s because the subject is [3rd person].
archetype_E_EDITING_ERROR_ANALYSIS.micro_capsula: > 🎧 **Editing Cue:** Read your report ALOUD before sending it on VHF. If a verb sounds 'naked' after 'the captain' or 'the vessel' — it probably needs -s.

grammar_targets_for_pm24.purpose: Bloque estructurado de Grammar Targets que PM-2.4 (Writing — dock report en S3) consumirá literalmente como criterios de andamiaje + checklist de edición. NO modificar IDs · NO modificar formulas · solo PM-2.4 puede consumir.
grammar_targets_for_pm24.writing_task_anclaje: Andrea writes a 60-word dock report to Captain Lopera describing where 4 port resources are located + 3 routine vessel operations (arrives / loads / departs).

targets.imarpor_example: The manifest is IN the office.
The container is ON the dock. The captain is AT the gangway.
The lifejacket is UNDER the seat. The crane is BEHIND the warehouse.

targets.structure: Prepositions of place — IN FRONT OF / NEXT TO / BETWEEN
targets.formula: [noun] + IS + IN FRONT OF / NEXT TO / BETWEEN + the + [port-noun] (+ AND + [port-noun])
targets.imarpor_example: The tug is IN FRONT OF the bow. The forklift is NEXT TO the container. The CML CARRIER is BETWEEN Berth 3 and Berth 4.

targets.structure: Simple present 3rd person -s (port operations · regular verbs)
targets.imarpor_example: The CML CARRIER arrives at 06:00. Andrea loads the manifest.
I AM Andrea. The captain IS Lopera. The containers ARE heavy.

targets.structure: there is / there are — declaring presence at the port
targets.formula: THERE IS + [singular noun] · THERE ARE + [plural noun]
targets.imarpor_example: THERE IS a tug at the bow. THERE ARE three containers at Berth 4.

targets.structure: Connector AND (sentence combining minimal · controlled production)
targets.imarpor_example: The CML CARRIER arrives at 06:00 AND the pilot is on the bridge.
targets.status_in_grammar_roadmap: SUPPORT S3 (light · enables sentence combining for 60-word report)
